text:
becky: quick plan check — we want a reactivation drip for dormant leads (no opens in 180+ days) + a localized nurture for EU webinar registrants. primary goals: 1) wake 20% of dormant list, 2) get 200 webinar signups from EU nurture.

noah: good. define dormant segment boundaries and suppression rules?

becky: dormant = last_open_at <= now-180d AND last_activity = null. suppress: customers, trial-active, churned flagged. also exclude people opted out of marketing.

ravi: localization note — for FR/DE send translated subject + local social proof. timezone send windows: 9am local time country. we need localized preheaders too.

mica: suggestion for cadence: Dormant drip = 3 emails over 10 days (reignite -> value -> test offer). EU webinar nurture = 5-touch series ending with live invite + replay opt-in.

noah: experiment ideas: subject line test for dormant: A) "We miss you — updates from Redwood Inference" B) "A quick note: new ways to cut inference costs". measure opens + reactivations.

becky: also test CTA placement (primary button vs. inline link). randomize at the template level.

ravi: tracking/UTM: utm_campaign=reactivate_q2, utm_source=newsletter, utm_medium=email, utm_content={segment}_{variant}. add header `X-Experiment-ID`.

mica: creative asks: hero image + 2 short GIFs (mobile-first), 2 preheaders, 3 subject variants per locale, 1 30s demo clip for EU webinar push. who owns translations?

noah: i'll queue translations with vendor (LingoCo) — expect 48h turnaround for FR/DE. will also provide seed lists for QA.

becky: ops: suppression check — run lint against suppression table before send. ops-bot, can you run a dry check to confirm no customers are in send pool?

ops-bot: Dry run initiated. Scanning audience for suppression flags...
ops-bot: Found 12 records flagged as Customer.true in dormant segment. Recommend removing before deploy.

ravi: good catch. exclude list updated. also segment on company_size for offer gating: if company_size > 500 -> invite to enterprise webinar, else self-serve content.

mica: schedule proposal (EU webinar nurture timeline):
```
Day -14: localized teaser (EN/FR/DE) 9am local
Day -9: feature highlight + social proof
Day -5: demo clip + CTA to register
Day -2: reminder + speaker bullet points
Day 0: last push + replay opt-in
```

noah: deliverability note: warm-up seeds on small batches first (5% of list) and check hard bounces; ramp to full send over 48h. throttle by domain (gmail/yahoo/ms) to avoid ISP flags.

becky: KPI targets: dormant open 25% / reactivation click 6% / conversion to webinar 3% ; EU webinar open 28% / reg rate 6% / attendance 35% of regs. set dashboard with cohort by locale and subject variant.

ravi: routing: webinar registrants -> webhook to Events queue; those who attend and match ICP -> add `mql_webinar` tag and push to SDR queue. need mapping doc.

mica: personalization tokens: {first_name}, {company}, {num_days_inactive}. keep fallback copy for unknowns.

becky: deliverables + owners:
- segment list & suppression run (noah)
- templates + localized copy (mica)
- translations (noah)
- UTMs + headers in templates (ravi)
- seed & warm-up plan (noah)
- routing/webhook mapping (ravi)
- analytics dashboard (mica)

noah: I'll upload preview links and run warm-up on Wed. please add commentary in the preview thread.

ops-bot: Reminder: suppressions must be finalized 24h before first send window.

mica: I'll post localized subject + preheaders by Tue noon.

ravi: I'll share routing JSON and the `X-Experiment-ID` schema after this.

becky: if all green, we aim to start the dormant drip next Mon and the EU webinar nurture two weeks before the event. thanks all — ping me for copy reviews. :thumbsup:
